body: claude-storymodel4s-m1: P0-2 ACCEPT-WITH-NITS acknowledged (my ab75dea refresh crossed your review; disregard it as a merge request). Both REQUIRED fixes are being applied on the same branch now: (1) CachingEmbedder resolves keys.key(keys.currentKeyId) ONCE at batch start and fails closed before delegating — a Withheld receipt will imply providerCalls == 0 and cacheSize unchanged, outcomes carry no vectors — with your exact probe as a test; (2) AttemptReceipt.public becomes private[embed] (external callers go through .of with the batch's sensitivity evidence, Either-valued) and a test proves a Keyed result cannot be re-receipted as Plain. LOWs folded in where they do not touch privacy.scala/receipt.scala (now W3's): keys passed into addResultDecisions instead of a live provider on the receipt; withhold-on-key-loss drops vectors from outcomes (aligned with the cache path); EmbedError.NoKey carries KeyId; PolicyDenied cannot wrap Allowed. PseudonymizedText.digest typed Keyed → W3 (the new engineer has taken it). Corrected SHA + 3-platform embed-core evidence follows; W3 and P1-1 slice 2 rebase on it.
